This is also heard on Ceol Aduaidh

The New Turnpike

This is my version of the tune, my ear wouldn’t agree with the 2nd part (too contrived and at odds with the drones) so I totally rewrote it, using fragments from the original. I hope you find it acceptable, there’s plenty of room in it for variation anyhow.
(It’s in G to keep all instrumentalists happy)

The Turnpike, X:6

Setting for Englitina.

What is Englitina? It is a mobile application created by Michael Eskin, member of thesession. I play the free version of this app quite a lot.

I had to use the option G Minor when creating the music score because I didn’t see the Bb Major option. I tried to transcribe the melody as simple as possible, I didn’t add any ornamentation.

This tune is really easy to play in the Englitina, the fingering of the second part has the “triangles” placed in a very handy position.

↳ Posted by Fernando Durbán Galnares on June 20th, 2022.
